title: feat(plugin-security): Setup People & Organization entries for position holders and permission-set assignment
body:
Fixes #28316

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none changed. `skills/**` has zero hits for People & Organization Setup navigation text. `content/docs/permissions/administrator-guide.mdx` (lines 51, 75, 209-211) and `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` (line 813, the `group_people_org` row) list the group's entries and do not yet name the two new pages; they are outside this claim's file surface and are worth a docs pass once the pages ship.

Lands after PR #28310 (the two app-shell pages). Before it merges, the entries are harmless: a component ref with no registration opens the console's not-found page.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup → 人员与组织 新增两个菜单项「岗位持有人」(security:position-holders) 和「权限集分配」(security:permission-set-assignment)，由 plugin-security 贡献，四种语言标签齐全。
- 为什么改：PR #28310 新增的两个分配页面只能手敲网址进入；Setup 菜单是服务端元数据，必须由服务端声明入口，管理员才能点到。
- 风险与回滚：极低，只加两条导航数据，不改任何权限或数据路径；回滚即 revert 本 PR。#28310 合并前点击会看到“组件不存在”页。
- 先看：packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts（新增的 group_people_org 贡献块）、packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/people-org-assignment-nav-contribution.test.ts、packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.ts。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/people-org-assignment-nav-contribution.test.ts`，预期 5 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（等 PR #28310 合并后再进队列）。

## What changes

- `@objectstack/plugin-security` contributes a second Setup navigation block, `group: 'group_people_org'`, priority 200 (after platform-objects' base entries at 100), with two items:
  - `nav_position_holders` · `type: 'component'` · label "Position Holders" · `componentRef: 'security:position-holders'` · icon `user-check`
  - `nav_permission_set_assignment` · `type: 'component'` · label "Permission Set Assignment" · `componentRef: 'security:permission-set-assignment'` · icon `key-round`
- **Gate:** copied from the plugin's Positions / Permission Sets entries, which carry none of their own (no `requiredPermissions`, `requiresService`, `requiresObject` or `visible`): the Setup app's `requiredPermissions: ['setup.access']` and the ungated group anchor decide who sees them (ADR-0146 D7 names the pages as the scope of `setup.access` and the delegated-administrator gate). The writes the pages make keep their own server-side gates. Riding plugin-security's manifest, the entries disappear wherever the plugin is not composed, exactly like the catalog entries.
- **Labels (measured owner):** plugin-security's own translation bundle has no `apps` section; every Setup nav label, plugin-security's catalog entries included, lives in `@objectstack/platform-objects`' hand-authored Setup bundles (`apps.setup.navigation.ID.label`). Both ids are added to all four locales that carry the group (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`), and each translated leaf's source digest is recorded in `LOCALE.source-hashes.ts` via `collectSourceHashes(en)` (control: the computed digest for `nav_positions` equals its recorded `517a2743f949b5f0`). No `*.generated.ts` file is involved; `pnpm check:i18n` confirms all generated bundles stay in sync.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-security` patch, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.

**Before (measured on `origin/main` b3394651):** `git grep "group: 'group_people_org'"` outside tests and translations names one contributor, `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`, whose block has 0 `componentRef` items; `git grep` for either ref outside `ui/` returns 0 files (control: `componentRef: 'automation:packaged'` returns 1 source hit).

## Tests

New `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/people-org-assignment-nav-contribution.test.ts` (5 cases), modelled on plugin-audit's `audit-nav-contribution.test.ts`: it runs the plugin's real `init()` and folds the Setup app through the real `SchemaRegistry`.

1. Both entries in one `group_people_org` contribution, with the exact `componentRef`s, as registry keys, and every contribution parses with `NavigationContributionSchema`.
2. Same gate as `nav_positions` and `nav_permission_sets`: the four gate keys compare equal (control: both catalog entries exist).
3. The rendered Setup nav serves both under People & Organization beside `nav_users`, the group anchor's gate equals Access Control's, and each ref opens in exactly one place.
4. Without plugin-security, neither entry appears, exactly where `nav_positions` / `nav_permission_sets` are also absent (control: `nav_users` still served).
5. Labels: ids are read off the manifest; every locale of the **served** `SetupAppTranslations` that carries `group_people_org` (measured: the four) labels both, `en` equals the declared label, and no translated locale serves the English string.

No existing test enumerates plugin-security's Setup entries; `setup-nav-dead-key-tombstone.test.ts` and `app-nav-translation-parity.test.ts` deliberately do not list Setup's contributed leaves (that is `pnpm check:app-nav-i18n`, which boots plugin-security and now judges 60 merged Setup ids, OK in 4 locales), so neither was extended.

### Ablations (each reverted, red shown, restored; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

| # | Mutation | Red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | delete both items from the plugin's contribution | cases 1, 2, 3, 5 (4 failed, 1 passed) |
| A2 | `security:position-holders` to `security:positions` | cases 1, 3 |
| A3 | add `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']` to `nav_permission_set_assignment` | case 2 |
| A4 | contribute the block to `group_access_control` | cases 1, 3, 5 |
| A5 | delete the zh-CN `nav_position_holders` label (platform-objects rebuilt) | case 5 (`zh-CN nav_position_holders: expected undefined to be truthy`) |
| A6 | platform-objects itself contributes `nav_position_holders` (rebuilt; dist preflight: marker present in 4 built files) | cases 3, 4 |
| A7 | es-ES `nav_permission_set_assignment` label set to the English string (rebuilt) | case 5 |

After the platform-objects legs, the package was rebuilt from HEAD; `dist/` carries the restored labels and the file reruns 5/5 green.

## Acceptance notes

- The ja-JP labels follow the Setup menu's own vocabulary ("ポジション", as the neighbouring Positions entry reads), not the page title PR #28310 ships ("役職の保持者"); es-ES likewise follows "Posiciones". The zh-CN labels match the page titles.
- `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs --absent` read the A5 / A7 markers as absent vacuously: esbuild escapes non-ASCII, so `dist/` never carries the raw spelling. The red runs themselves prove those mutations reached `dist/` (an undefined label; the English string served), and the restored escaped spellings were read back from `dist/apps/index.mjs` directly.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security` vitest: Test Files 238 passed (238), Tests 5124 passed, 45 skipped. Exit 0.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects` vitest: Test Files 104 passed (104), Tests 1474 passed. Exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` exit 0.
- `pnpm build` (full, under the verify lock) exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 62 families, each run with its exit code recorded before any pipe. Three first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no built tree, or the lock queue) and were rerun after the full build: `check:i18n` exit 0 (10 packages, all bundles in sync), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 0, `check:type-check-debt` exit 0. `--ran`: "62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 62 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
